title.quote:
Bugs in Machine Learning-based Systems: A
Faultload Benchmark
title.justification: Title as printed on the paper.
title.value: Bugs in Machine Learning-based Systems: A Faultload Benchmark

extractions.description: The paper studies reproducibility and verifiability of bugs in ML-based systems and introduces defect4ML, a faultload benchmark of 100 real bugs collected from GitHub commits and Stack Overflow posts for TensorFlow and Keras applications. It also presents a small case study comparing two ML testing tools (NeuraLint and DeepLocalize) on a subset of the benchmark bugs.

type.justification: The paper performs empirical mining/manual inspection of bugs and builds a benchmark, plus an empirical case study of two tools.

name.justification: The paper explicitly targets SRE of ML-based systems.
